subject: MATH251
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering all 5 topics. The English selections are dominated by highly-rated, popular channels like MIT OCW, The Math Sorcerer, and Dr. Trefor Bazett. The Arabic selections feature prominent regional educators like Anas Abu Zahra and provide solid coverage, though the pool of candidates for some advanced topics was smaller.

videos.title: One-to-one, Onto, and the Big Theorem Part II
